meta.title: Contivo roadmap: what is being built, and what shipped
meta.description: What Contivo is building now, next and later, with no dates promised, and a dated list of what has already shipped.

roadmap.headline: What comes next, in order. <accent>Not</accent> by date.
roadmap.intro: The order is a plan; a date would be a promise we could break. When something ships it moves to the list below, with the day it went in.

next.title: Next
next.body: Designed, and the next to be built.

channels.title: X, Telegram, WordPress and Threads
channels.body: The publishing core they share shipped on 22 November. Each channel is switched on only after a real post has gone out through it.

billing.title: Paid plans
billing.body: Founder, Growth and Agency, as priced on the pricing page. Until billing starts, new accounts are free.

monitoring.title: Weekly competitor watch
monitoring.body: A weekly re-read of every confirmed competitor, and a list of what changed on their site, prices or positioning.

imageQuality.title: Choose image quality
imageQuality.body: Fast, standard or HD per image, so a throwaway and a hero image do not cost the same.

imageTemplate.title: Your brand on images
imageTemplate.body: Headline and logo drawn over the image in your colours and a real font, so the text is right, including Persian.

video.title: Video scripts and template videos
video.body: Scripts you can shoot, and short videos made without a camera.

agency.title: White-label reports and client links
agency.body: The strategy report under an agency's own brand, and a link a client can open without an account.

networks.title: Instagram, Facebook and TikTok
networks.body: Each one needs its platform's app review first, so the timing is partly theirs.

languages.title: More content languages
languages.body: Writing in languages beyond English and Persian.

roadmap.note: Order can change when customers tell us something matters more. Anything we drop is removed from this page, not left to go stale.
roadmap.shippedIntro: Changes a customer would notice, with the day each one went into the product.

ownPost.title: Write your own post, and edit a published one
ownPost.body: Add a post in your own words to the pipeline, and correct a live article in place.

failover.title: Another AI provider takes over
failover.body: If one provider is down, the next one picks up the work, and the switch is logged.

security.title: Security fixes to publishing and site connections
security.body: Publishing is tied to your own workspace, and a site's refresh address cannot be pointed at internal systems.

tokens.title: Connected accounts encrypted
tokens.body: Tokens for connected social accounts are encrypted at rest.

discovery.title: Competitor discovery and charts on evidence
discovery.body: Competitors are found with the evidence they were found on, and every chart score shows its reasoning.

report.title: A new strategy report
report.body: Our template, with the model writing only the prose and never placing chart points.

persian.title: Persian
persian.body: The whole product, and the writing itself, in Persian.
